exercises.title: Count, busiest, silent
exercises.task: Error timestamps from a long incident, sorted. Write three functions: Count (errors in a time range, fast enough for 50 000 queries on 500 000 errors), Busiest (the window of a given width with the most errors), Silences (gaps with no error, which often mean the service was down, not healthy). The spec is in the file.
hints: Count: two binary searches for boundaries (1.5.1): the first index with ts[i] >= from and the first with ts[i] >= to. sort.SearchInts is allowed here.
Busiest: a window [ts[left], ts[left]+width); move right forward while ts[right] is inside, then the count is right - left. When left moves, right never goes back: O(n).
Silences: one pass comparing each timestamp with the next.
